items.reason: The record plans "the pharmacologic (PK/PD) response ... in pre- versus posttreatment glioblastoma tissue" and states that "Tissue, CSF, and plasma will be collected during the post-treatment surgical intervention", so PK is planned and tumour tissue and CSF are named as samples. But the readout is described as "molecular (transcriptomic, proteomic and/or metabolomic) tissue level changes", not LMP744 concentration. W7 reserves 'unclear' for a missing sample type, which leaves yes and no; no ruling covers this.
